meta.transitPolicy: All 18 activities sit inside Manhattan, Brooklyn (DUMBO), or NY Harbor ferries from Battery Park/Whitehall. From any of the top-ranked Chelsea/NoMad/Tribeca/FiDi hotels, every activity below is reachable in 4 to 39 minutes by MTA subway/bus or walking — 100% compliant with the ≤1-hour travel rule.
meta.pricingPolicy: Couple totals (2 adults) are computed strictly from published out-of-state adult general admission on each venue's official website. Free days/hours are noted in Exceptions.

items.name: Statue of Liberty National Monument & Ellis Island
items.address: Battery Park departure (Castle Clinton) → Liberty Island & Ellis Island
items.exceptions: Last entry into Statue 15:30. Closed only Thanksgiving & Dec 25. Pedestal ($26.30) & Crown ($26.30) reserve tickets sell out months ahead — book only via official concessionaire Statue City Cruises.
items.costTwoAdults: $52.00 General Ferry + Audio Tour (2 × $26.00) · $52.60 Pedestal or Crown Reserve (2 × $26.30)
items.transitNote: ≤25 min subway [1 or 4/5] from Chelsea/NoMad to South Ferry / Bowling Green; ~10 min walk from FiDi hotels

items.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art (The Met Fifth Avenue)
items.address: 1000 Fifth Avenue (at 82nd St), New York, NY 10028
items.exceptions: Closed Wednesdays, Thanksgiving, Dec 25, Jan 1, and first Monday in May. Fri/Sat Date Night open until 21:00.
items.transitNote: 25–39 min via [4/5/6] to 86th St (measured 39 min from Eurostars Wall St; ~22 min from NoMad)
flags: Confirm Wednesday closure on metmuseum.org right before trip (older cached snippets differed).

items.name: Museum of Modern Art (MoMA)
items.exceptions: Open daily except Thanksgiving & Dec 25. Galleries clear ~15 min before closing. Shares building with 2★ The Modern.
items.transitNote: 14–32 min via [E/M] to 5 Av/53 St or [B/D/F/M] to Rockefeller Ctr (measured 32 min from Wall St; ~15 min from Chelsea)

items.name: American Museum of Natural History ( & Gilder Center)
items.address: 200 Central Park West (at 79th St), New York, NY 10024
items.exceptions: Closed Thanksgiving & Dec 25. Timed-entry reservation required; special exhibitions (Invisible Worlds, Hayden Planetarium) require +One or +All upgrade.
items.transitNote: 20–34 min via [B/C] to 81st St–Museum of Natural History or [1] to 79th St (measured 34 min from Wall St)

items.name: National September 11 Memorial & Museum
items.daysOpen: Memorial: Daily · Museum: Wed–Mon (Closed most Tuesdays)
items.hours: Outdoor Memorial: Daily 08:00–20:00 · Museum: Wed–Mon & select Tuesdays 09:00–19:00 (last entry 17:30)
items.exceptions: Museum closed most Tuesdays (check calendar for select holiday Tuesdays, e.g., Presidents' Week). Free Museum admission Mondays 17:30–19:00 (tickets release Mondays at 07:00 online).
items.costTwoAdults: $0 Outdoor Memorial · $72.00 Museum Admission (2 × $36.00 on visit.911memorial.org)
items.transitNote: 5–10 min walk from Tribeca/FiDi hotels; ~18 min via [1] or [E] from Chelsea/NoMad

items.name: Whitney Museum of American Art
items.hours: Mon, Wed, Thu, Sat, Sun 10:30–18:00; Fri 10:30–22:00; Tue closed
items.exceptions: FREE Friday Nights 17:00–22:00 and FREE every Second Sunday (advance online ticket reservation required). Pairs directly with southern entrance of The High Line.
items.transitNote: 12–18 min via [A/C/E] or [L] to 14 St / 8 Av from Chelsea, NoMad, Tribeca, or FiDi

items.name: Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum
items.address: 1071 Fifth Avenue (at 88th St), New York, NY 10128
items.exceptions: Pay-What-You-Wish Tuesdays & Sundays 16:00–17:30; Members-only hours select Mondays 18:00–20:00.
items.transitNote: 25–40 min via [4/5/6] to 86th St (6 blocks north of The Met)

items.name: The High Line Elevated Park
items.address: Gansevoort St to 34th St (between 10th & 12th Aves), New York, NY
items.exceptions: Rail Yard Preserve section (30th–34th Sts) closes at dusk. Weather/ice path closures posted on @highlinenyc.
items.transitNote: 10-min walk from Hyatt Place Chelsea & DoubleTree Chelsea; ~18 min via [A/C/E] from Downtown

items.name: Central Park (Bethesda Terrace, Bow Bridge & The Mall)
items.address: 5th Ave to Central Park West, 59th St to 110th St, New York, NY
items.exceptions: Posted entrance signs govern specific drives/lawns; winter conditions apply in Feb–Mar.
items.transitNote: 12–28 min via [N/R/W], [1/2/3], or [A/B/C/D] to 59th St / Columbus Circle or 5th Ave

items.name: Top of the Rock Observation Deck (Rockefeller Center)
items.address: 30 Rockefeller Plaza (enter on 50th St between 5th & 6th Aves), New York, NY 10112
items.exceptions: Sunset time slots carry a surcharge; The Beam & Skylift are optional paid add-ons. Direct view of Empire State Building & Central Park.
items.transitNote: 12–26 min via [B/D/F/M] to 47–50 Sts Rockefeller Ctr (walking distance from Midtown dining cluster)

items.name: Empire State Building Observatory (86th & 102nd Floors)
items.hours: Date-specific variable schedule (check esbnyc.com calendar for exact Feb/Mar 2027 day)
items.exceptions: Open 365 days including Presidents' Day, but exact opening/closing hours vary by date and are released closer to travel.
items.costTwoAdults: $93.00 86th Fl Best-Value Online (2 × $44 + $5 order fee) · $158.00+ 86th & 102nd Fl Combo (from 2 × $79)
items.transitNote: 5–8 min walk from DoubleTree Chelsea, Arlo NoMad, and The Evelyn; ~18 min [4/5] or [2/3] from Downtown

social.label: TikTok (@marikatraveltips ESB vs Top of Rock vs Summit)

items.name: SUMMIT One Vanderbilt
items.address: 45 East 42nd Street (enter via Main Concourse, Grand Central Terminal), New York, NY 10017
items.daysOpen: Check calendar (historically closed Tuesdays in winter; Sunday 08:00–24:00 confirmed on FAQ)
items.hours: 08:00–24:00 (last entry 22:30) on operating days — verify exact Feb 2027 day-of-week schedule
items.exceptions: Tickets are non-refundable for low visibility (rebooking offered). Wear pants/flats due to mirrored floors.
items.transitNote: 12–22 min via [4/5/6], [7], or [S] to Grand Central–42 St (1 block from Sushi Sho 3★ & Gabriel Kreuther 2★)
flags: Dynamic timed-ticket checkout price for Feb 2027 and weekday operating calendar require live Webstore check; couple cost left blank rather than citing third-party ~$40 estimates.

items.name: Bank of America Winter Village at Bryant Park (The Rink & The Lodge)
items.address: Bryant Park (between 40th & 42nd Sts and 5th & 6th Aves), New York, NY 10018
items.hours: Rink: Daily 08:00–22:00 · The Lodge Bar + Food Hall: Daily 10:00–22:00
items.exceptions: CRITICAL DATE CUTOFF: Holiday Shops close 3 Jan 2027; The Rink & The Lodge close for the season on **28 February 2027** (unavailable if traveling in March 2027). Skating admission is free with own skates; skate rental varies by peak/off-peak slot.
items.costTwoAdults: $0.00 Rink Admission (bring own skates; timed skate-rental pricing varies dynamically online)
items.transitNote: 10–18 min via [B/D/F/M] or [7] to 42 St–Bryant Park (directly across from 2★ Gabriel Kreuther & NYPL)
flags: Closes 28 Feb 2027 — any March 2027 trip dates miss this activity.

items.name: Wollman Rink in Central Park
items.address: 830 5th Ave (enter Central Park at 59th St & 6th Ave), New York, NY 10065
items.exceptions: Note early 14:30 closure on Mondays & Tuesdays! Presidents' Week (Feb 15–21) typically triggers Peak/Prime calendar tiers vs. Off-Peak after Feb 22.
items.costTwoAdults: $32 Off-Peak · $56 Peak · $80 Prime Admission (2 × $16/$28/$40) + $24 Skate Rental (2 × $12)
items.transitNote: 15–28 min via [N/R/W] to 5th Ave/59th St or [F] to 57th St

items.name: New York Public Library — Stephen A. Schwarzman Building
items.address: 476 Fifth Avenue (at 42nd St), New York, NY 10018
items.exceptions: Rose Main Reading Room tourist visiting window is strictly 10:00–11:00 Mon–Sat (last entry 10:50) unless using research materials or joining a docent tour. Closed on Presidents' Day (Mon 15 Feb 2027 — verify holiday list).
items.transitNote: Adjacent to Bryant Park; 10–18 min from Chelsea/NoMad/FiDi via [7], [B/D/F/M], or [4/5/6]
flags: Different NYPL subpages occasionally show holiday-week adjustments; check Presidents' Day (15 Feb 2027) closure before visiting.

items.name: Staten Island Ferry (Harbor & Statue of Liberty Skyline Cruise)
items.address: Whitehall Ferry Terminal, 4 South Street, New York, NY 10004
items.hours: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week (typically every 30 min; 15–20 min rush hours)
items.exceptions: Passengers must disembark at St. George Terminal before re-boarding return boat (~25 min each way). Runs holiday/weekend schedule on Presidents' Day.
items.transitNote: 8-min walk from Eurostars Wall St; ~22 min via [1] to South Ferry or [R/W] to Whitehall St from Chelsea/NoMad

items.name: Brooklyn Bridge Pedestrian Promenade & DUMBO Waterfront
items.address: Brooklyn Bridge Promenade (Centre St / City Hall Park or Washington St, DUMBO)
items.hours: Open 24 hours daily (dedicated elevated pedestrian boardwalk; bikes have separate lane)
items.exceptions: High wind chill over East River in February — best walked Brooklyn → Manhattan facing the skyline.
items.transitNote: 5-min walk from The Beekman / Frederick Tribeca; ~20 min via [A/C] to High St–Brooklyn Bridge or [4/5/6] to Brooklyn Bridge–City Hall
